description: MX, SPF (SPFM merge), DKIM (optional dkim2 group), and DMARC for Dub partner email domains.
variableDescription: %mxHost%: hostname for the bounce MX (typically send, or send.<subdomain> for subdomain email domains). %mxValue%: MX target (e.g. feedback-smtp.<region>.amazonses.com). %spfTxtHost%: hostname for the SPF policy (typically same as mxHost). %spfTxtValue%: SPFM merge mechanisms only (without the "v=spf1" prefix and typically without the trailing "all" mechanism); see SPFM merging in the Domain Connect specification. %dkimTxtHost%, %dkim2TxtHost%: full zone-relative DKIM TXT hostnames (e.g. resend._domainkey or resend._domainkey.partners). %dkimTxtValue%, %dkim2TxtValue%: Full DKIM TXT value from Dub (normally starting with "v=DKIM1;"). %dmarcHost%: DMARC TXT hostname (_dmarc or _dmarc.<subdomain>).
